Meet Our Team

Our architects and designers bring together diverse expertise, creativity, and a shared commitment to excellence. With backgrounds spanning residential, commercial, and cultural projects, we collaborate to deliver thoughtful designs that enrich communities.

Sarah Chen

Principal Architect

Sarah founded Archway Studio in 2015 with a vision to create architecture that balances aesthetics with sustainability. She holds a Master's degree from MIT and has led award-winning projects in residential and institutional design. Her work has been featured in Architectural Digest and Design Weekly.

Michael Torres

Senior Designer

Michael specializes in interior design and spatial planning with 12 years of experience. His keen eye for detail and commitment to creating functional, beautiful spaces has made him essential to our studio's success. Michael completed his architecture degree at the University of Oregon.

Dr. James Wright

Heritage & Conservation Specialist

James brings expertise in heritage restoration and adaptive reuse projects. With a PhD in Architectural History, he ensures our work honors the past while creating vibrant spaces for the future. He has consulted on over 30 heritage restoration projects across North America.

Emily Rodriguez

Junior Architect

Emily recently joined our team after graduating from Portland State University. Her passion for sustainable design and digital modeling has already made an impact on several projects. She is pursuing her architecture license while contributing fresh ideas and enthusiasm to the studio.

David Patel

Project Manager

David oversees project timelines, budgets, and client coordination with meticulous attention to detail. His background in construction management and his relationships with local contractors ensure our designs are realized beautifully and on schedule. He has managed projects valued at over $50 million.

Lisa Anderson

Studio Administrator

Lisa keeps Archway Studio organized and running smoothly. She manages scheduling, finances, and vendor relationships while providing excellent support to our clients and team. Her warm professionalism and problem-solving skills are vital to our daily operations.

Our Values

Collaboration

We believe in the power of diverse perspectives. Our team works closely with clients, contractors, and consultants to create designs that are thoughtful and achievable.

Sustainability

Every project considers environmental impact. We design for longevity, energy efficiency, and the well-being of communities and ecosystems.

Innovation

We embrace new technologies and design thinking while respecting timeless principles. Our work pushes boundaries without losing humanity.

Integrity

We are honest, transparent, and committed to our clients. Our reputation is built on delivering quality work and maintaining professional excellence.

Ready to Work Together?

Have a project in mind? We'd love to hear from you. Contact us to discuss how Archway Studio can bring your vision to life.

pages.html:
⌐ Archway Studio
HomeProjectsServicesTeamContact

Our Services

At Archway Studio, we offer comprehensive architectural and design services tailored to bring your vision to life. From initial concept through final construction, we guide every step of your project.

Architectural Design

Custom architectural solutions for residential, commercial, and institutional projects. We blend innovative design with practical functionality to create spaces that inspire and endure.

  • Conceptual design and master planning
  • Detailed design development
  • Construction documentation
  • Building code compliance

Interior Design

Transform interiors through thoughtful spatial planning, material selection, and aesthetic refinement. We create functional environments that reflect your lifestyle and values.

  • Space planning and layout
  • Material and finish selection
  • Lighting design
  • Furniture and fixture specification

Renovation & Restoration

Breathe new life into existing structures. Whether modernizing a heritage property or updating dated spaces, we respect original character while introducing contemporary comfort and efficiency.

  • Feasibility studies and assessments
  • Heritage preservation planning
  • Energy efficiency upgrades
  • Adaptive reuse design

Project Management

Navigate the complexities of construction with confidence. Our project management services ensure timely delivery, budget control, and seamless coordination between all stakeholders.

  • Budget planning and cost control
  • Contractor coordination
  • Timeline management
  • Quality assurance oversight

Consultation & Planning

Get expert guidance before committing to a full project. Our consultants assess your needs, explore possibilities, and provide strategic recommendations to inform your decisions.

  • Site analysis and evaluation
  • Feasibility consulting
  • Design strategy sessions
  • Second-opinion reviews

Sustainability & Green Design

Build responsibly with integrated sustainability practices. We optimize energy performance, material selection, and environmental impact to create healthier, more efficient spaces.

  • LEED certification guidance
  • Energy modeling and analysis
  • Sustainable material sourcing
  • Climate-responsive design

Our Design Process

We follow a thoughtful, collaborative approach to every project. Here's how we work:

1

Discovery & Consultation

We start by listening. Through in-depth conversations, site visits, and research, we understand your goals, constraints, and vision. This foundation guides everything that follows.

2

Concept Development

Our designers explore multiple design directions through sketches, models, and preliminary renderings. We test ideas, refine concepts, and present options for your feedback and input.

3

Design Development

Once you approve a concept, we develop it into detailed designs. Plans, elevations, and 3D visualizations take shape, addressing all technical requirements and aesthetic refinements.

4

Documentation & Permitting

Our team prepares comprehensive construction documents and navigates the permitting process. We ensure compliance with all codes and regulations, managing submissions and revisions with authorities.

5

Construction Administration

During construction, we provide regular site visits, answer contractor questions, review progress, and ensure the built result matches our designs. We maintain quality and address any unforeseen challenges.

6

Project Completion

We conduct final walkthroughs, ensure all punch-list items are complete, and transition the project to you. Our relationship doesn't end at handover—we're here for ongoing support.

Ready to Start Your Project?

Whether you're beginning to explore possibilities or ready to move forward, we'd love to hear from you. Let's discuss how Archway Studio can bring your architectural vision to reality.
